I am 56 years old and I have been farming this land since I was a boy. I went to primary school so I can read the writing on the fertilizer bag, but I still decide mostly by what I have seen with my own eyes and what my neighbors do. I own these 6.37 hectares, so I am willing to put some money into it, but I am also careful because a bad season means I lose cash I cannot easily replace. Last season I used some improved seed and subsidized fertilizer, and the yield was better than my brother's plot, so I will do the same this year. I will buy what I can from the agro-dealer when the voucher subsidy is available, but I will not buy pesticide or herbicide because those bottles are too expensive and I do not have a sprayer — my family and the casual laborers will weed with hoes like we always do. There is no river near this field, so I wait for the November rains and I do not irrigate.
